newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Grenfell to face intermediaries' claims - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell to face intermediaries' claims - WSJ.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ltd, a subsidiary of Deutsche Bank AG, will soon face claims from financial intermediaries, the Wall Street Journal Europe said on Friday.
The paper quoted Anthony Yadgaroff, group managing director at performance analysts Allenbridge Group Plc, as saying losses by intermediaries could total between five and 10 million stg.

Last month Morgan Grenfell finalised a 200 million stg compensation package to investors following irregularities in valuations of unlisted securities in some of MGAM's unit trusts. MGAM has sacked fund manager Peter Young and four other senior managers.
Yadgaroff said he was forming an action group for those who introduced business to Morgan Grenfell.
He said financial intermediaries had lost commissions and clients and spent a lot of resources talking to customers.
A Morgan Grenfell spokesman said the issue of compensation for independent financial advisers was being reviewed.
